candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Silencing putative PTEN ceRNAs (SERINC1, VAPA, CNOT6L, ZNF460, PTEN) decreased luciferase activity of a chimeric construct with the PTEN 3'UTR
candidates.citation_sentence: This is similar to what was reported in Figure 3C and Supplemental Figure S3A of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 1 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Overexpression of the 3'UTRs of putative PTEN ceRNAs (SERINC1, VAPA, CNOT6L, PTEN) increased luciferase activity, suggesting inhibition of PTEN 3'UTR was relieved
candidates.citation_sentence: This is similar to what was reported in Figure 3D of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 2 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: Most comparisons show statistically significant effects in the opposite direction from the original, but VAPA 3'UTR1 was not statistically significant after Bonferroni correction. A second coder might plausibly classify this as reversal given the dominant pattern of opposite-direction significance. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Depletion of putative PTEN ceRNAs (SERINC1, VAPA, CNOT6L) decreased PTEN protein expression, and this effect was attenuated when DICER was disrupted
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 3G–H and Supplemental Figure S3B of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 3 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: Results were generally in the same direction as the original but varied in statistical significance across comparisons and cell lines; some comparisons were significant, others were not. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Depletion of putative PTEN ceRNAs (VAPA, CNOT6L, PTEN) increased cell proliferation in DU145 cells
candidates.citation_sentence: This is similar to what was reported in Figure 5B of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 4 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: Results varied in both statistical significance and direction relative to the original across ceRNA conditions; PTEN depletion was in the same direction as the original but not all ceRNA depletions were. [ling26: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Depletion of candidate PTEN ceRNAs SERINC1, VAPA, and CNOT6L reduces activity of a luciferase reporter containing the PTEN 3′UTR.
candidates.citation_sentence: This is similar to what was reported in Figure 3C and Supplemental Figure S3A of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 1 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: The replication authors report that the planned comparisons for candidate PTEN ceRNAs were not statistically significant and that effects varied in direction relative to the original. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Overexpression of the 3′UTRs of candidate PTEN ceRNAs increases activity of a luciferase reporter containing the PTEN 3′UTR.
candidates.citation_sentence: This is similar to what was reported in Figure 3D of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 2 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: The replication effects were generally statistically significant and in the opposite direction from the original, except for the VAPA 3′UTR1 comparison, which was not statistically significant; therefore this is not an unambiguous reversal. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Depletion of candidate PTEN ceRNAs decreases PTEN protein expression in wild-type cells through a microRNA-dependent mechanism that is attenuated when DICER is disrupted.
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 3G–H and Supplemental Figure S3B of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 3 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: Results were generally in the same direction in wild-type cells but varied in statistical significance, and the expected attenuation in Dicer[Ex5] cells was not observed. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]

candidates.original_title: Coding-independent regulation of the tumor suppressor PTEN by competing endogenous mRNAs
candidates.description: Depletion of candidate PTEN ceRNAs VAPA and CNOT6L increases cell proliferation through a DICER-dependent mechanism.
candidates.citation_sentence: This is similar to what was reported in Figure 5B of Tay et al., 2011 and described in Protocol 4 in the Registered Report (Phelps et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: Replication results varied in statistical significance and direction for the candidate PTEN ceRNAs, while PTEN depletion produced an effect in the same direction as the original. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
